# LLMExp

> Independent technical notes and interactive tutorials on large language model systems, reinforcement learning, and agent evaluation.

Official website: https://zerograd-x.github.io/
Language: English for the blog; some interactive tutorials are in Chinese.

## Technical writing
- [Blog index](https://zerograd-x.github.io/blog/): Published engineering notes.
- [Optimizing Constrained Decoding](https://zerograd-x.github.io/blog/optimizing-constrained-decoding/): Candidate-driven trie traversal, exclusion filtering, native execution, CUDA synchronization, correctness, and benchmarking methodology. Examples are illustrative and do not report proprietary speedups.

## Interactive tutorials
- [FlashAttention](https://zerograd-x.github.io/FlashAttention/)
- [Policy Gradient](https://zerograd-x.github.io/PolicyGradient/)
- [TRPO](https://zerograd-x.github.io/TRPO/)
- [PPO](https://zerograd-x.github.io/PPO/)
- [GRPO](https://zerograd-x.github.io/GRPO/)
- [RL algorithm comparison](https://zerograd-x.github.io/RLCompare/)
